progression.narrative: The performance opens on F4 and dwells most on F# in Pas-Hesar. The line peaks at Bk4 (485.4 Hz) at 0:35.3. It closes on F#4, not the tonic (F#4 → Gs4 → F#4 → Bk4 → Ds4 → F#4).
